title: Mail
description: Mail is a modern plugin for Minecraft servers that adds a full—fledged system for transferring items between players through mail requests.
body:
_**Mail is a modern plugin for Minecraft servers that adds a full—fledged system for transferring items between players through mail requests. The plugin makes the exchange of items simple, transparent and fraud-proof.**_

**What does this project add?**

A mail request system: players can send any items to each other, and the recipient decides whether to accept or reject the transfer.
Multilingual: supports Russian, English and Chinese languages. All messages are easily configurable.
Flexible customization: the administrator can limit the types and number of items transferred, set up the economy, notifications, limits, and more.
User-friendly interface: all commands are combined into one (/mail), there is auto-completion of arguments (tab-complete), GUI support (optional).
Security: spam protection, item availability verification, logging of all transfers, black and white list of items.

**Main functions**

Transfer of items:
/mail send <item> <amount> <player> — send an item to another player.
Confirmation or rejection:
/mail accept <player> — accept, /mail deny <player> — reject the request.
Cancel all your requests:
/mail cancel
Help for commands:
/mail help
Reloading settings and languages:
/mail reload (for admins)
Auto-completion:
Hints for all sub-teams, items and players.
Multilingualism:
All messages are configured in separate language files.

**Why should I download Mail?**

Safe: eliminates the possibility of cheating when exchanging items.
Convenient: all actions are performed via one command, with hints and clear messages.
Flexible: adapts easily to any server thanks to a variety of settings.
International: Multi-language support out of the box.
Who is this plugin for?
For servers where honesty and transparency of exchange between players is important.
For projects with an international audience.
For administrators who value flexibility and ease of configuration.

_Mail is your choice if you want to make the exchange of items on the server honest, convenient and modern!_
